name: e2e-history-window-race
title: Make the e2e history assertion deterministic
description: e2e/run.mjs:292 compares the rendered message window against everything the pagination loop loaded. ChatWindow keeps the render window at least as large as the loaded messages, but only after an effect flush, so the assertion reads the DOM too early and fails intermittently (observed once in four local runs on an unchanged app). Wait for the window to catch up instead of hoping for timing.
creator: xupeng
